text: Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, was now an old man. And his wife, Sarah, alayhas salaam, had never had a child.
One day, guests entered upon him. Strangers, a people unknown. They said: peace. He said: peace.
Ibrahim, alayhis salaam, did not delay. He went to his family, and came back with a fat roasted calf.
He placed it near them and said: "Will you not eat?" But their hands did not reach for it. And he felt afraid of them.
They said: do not fear. We are messengers, sent to the people of Lut. And they gave him good news.
His wife, who was standing nearby, smiled. And they gave her the good news of a son, Ishaq, and after Ishaq, Yaqub, alayhimus salaam.

She said: shall I give birth, when I am an old woman, and my husband is an old man? This is an amazing thing! They said: "Are you amazed at the decree of Allah? May the mercy of Allah and His blessings be upon you, people of the house."

From Ismail, alayhis salaam, would come the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him. From Ishaq, alayhis salaam, would come Yaqub, Yusuf, Musa, Dawud, Sulaiman and Isa, alayhimus salaam. And Allah placed prophethood and the Book among his descendants.
